summary: Rental car broken into at a viewpoint near Sintra
story: On July 14 we parked our rental car at a viewpoint near Sintra for about an hour. When we came back the rear window was smashed. My backpack was gone from the back seat, with my laptop and a jacket, and the glove compartment had been forced and my sunglasses and a charger taken. I went to the police that afternoon. I am also claiming the rental company's bill for the window.

items.description: Laptop, in the backpack on the rear seat
Jacket, in the backpack on the rear seat
Prescription sunglasses, taken from the glove compartment
Portable charger, taken from the glove compartment
Rental company's bill for the rear window

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Policia de Seguranca Publica, Sintra. Report made July 14, 2026 at 16:40 by Tomas Brandt. A rental car parked at the Monserrate viewpoint was entered at about 14:30 by breaking the rear window. A backpack was taken from the rear seat. The glove compartment, which had been locked, was forced and prescription sunglasses and a charger were taken. The trunk was not opened.

documents.content: Laptop, bought 2025: $1,150.00. Jacket: $210.00. Prescription sunglasses, bought 2026: $260.00. Charger: $45.00.

documents.content: Rear window replacement, charged to the renter: $380.00.

summary: Phone snatched from my hand on the promenade
story: On August 3 I was walking on the promenade at Cascais and checking directions on my phone when a man on a scooter grabbed it out of my hand and rode off. I reported it to the police within the hour. I had been swimming earlier but my bag was with me the whole time. The phone was bought fourteen months ago and I added Electronics Plus when I bought the policy.

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Policia de Seguranca Publica, Cascais. Report made August 3, 2026 at 18:05 by Priya Nair. At about 17:30 on the Marginal promenade a man on a scooter took her phone from her hand.

summary: Disc pain and sciatica needing an emergency admission in Santiago
story: On August 6 I woke with severe pain down my left leg and could not stand. I was admitted overnight in Santiago and had an MRI. I did have some back trouble last spring, but it was a simple strain in April and it cleared up. Once I got home I had four physiotherapy sessions, which I have also listed.

items.description: Four physiotherapy sessions at home after the trip

documents.name: Hospital bill and records
documents.content: Clinica Santa Maria, Santiago, August 6 to 7, 2026. Diagnosis: lumbar disc herniation with left sciatica. Referral letter from the patient's physician in Seattle, enclosed: April 10, 2026, visit for a lower back strain, naproxen 250 mg twice daily prescribed. May 30, 2026, telephone review, pain persisting, naproxen increased to 500 mg twice daily. No visits after that date.

documents.name: Itemized bill
documents.content: Emergency assessment $540.00; MRI $1,180.00; orthopedic consultation $320.00; medication $46.50; overnight observation $610.00.

summary: Held overnight in Split by a ferry crew strike on the way home
story: Our ferry from Split to Ancona on September 13 was due to leave at 20:00 and left at 09:00 the next morning because the crew went on strike. We stayed at a hotel near the port, ate at the quay and took taxis. We paid cash for the meals and have no receipts for them. We also lost our first night's hotel in Bologna, which we had already paid for.

items.description: Hotel in Split, one room, one night
Meals for two at the quay, cash
First night's prepaid hotel in Bologna, missed

documents.name: Ferry delay confirmation
documents.content: Adria Lines. Sailing AL 212 Split to Ancona, scheduled September 13, 2026 at 20:00, departed September 14 at 09:00 because of a strike by the crew. Passengers: Owen Castell and Mara Castell.

documents.content: Hotel Marjan, September 13 to 14, one room: $410.00. Taxis, receipts 8841 and 8842: $18.00 and $18.00. Hotel Torre, Bologna, no-show September 14: $140.00.

summary: Trip to Vietnam cancelled after my position was cut
story: My employer cut my position on August 14, through no fault of mine, and I could not afford to take the trip on August 20. I had worked there for almost a year. The airline and the hotel will not refund me. I would like my costs back.

documents.name: Letter from the employer
documents.content: Harbor Freight Logistics. This confirms that your employment, which began on October 6, 2025, ended on August 14, 2026 because your position was eliminated in a restructuring. You did nothing wrong.

documents.name: Supplier confirmations
documents.content: Skylark Airways: ticket not refundable, $1,480.00. Hotel Lotus: prepaid stay not refundable, $820.00.
